text:
Type: potted aloe succulent
Use: greenery on a windowsill, a desk or a shelf; living room, home office, kitchen
Style: bohemian, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: live succulent with thick fleshy leaves, terracotta-colored plastic nursery pot
Colors: fresh green with pale speckles, terracotta orange
Shape: upright rosette of long spiky pointed leaves that fan out from the center, small round pot, compact and sculptural
Feel: fresh, natural, easygoing, lively
Goes with: ceramic or woven cachepots, light wood, white walls, sunny windows; bohemian or Scandinavian rooms
